neighbours.label: The token right after a lone '1' that turns out to start a larger quantity: '1 700 m', '1 1/2 hours', '1 out of every 3'. The - pole takes the plain 'one' / '1' (pronoun 'one', digits inside identifiers).
fire: The silo can store roughly 1 500 tonnes of grain.
Simmer the stock for 1 1/2 hours, then strain.
Nearly 1 out of every 6 households has no car.
The pipeline runs for about 1 300 km across the plain.
Add 1 1/4 cups of flour and stir.
Around 1 out of every 10 patients reports side effects.
The stadium seats close to 1 800 spectators.
Let the dough rise for 1 3/4 hours in a warm place.
quiet: The silo was the one building left standing on the farm.
Simmer the stock for 45 minutes, then strain.
Nearly every household on the street has no car.
The pipeline runs for about 300 km across the plain.
Add 3/4 cup of flour and stir.
No one among the patients reports side effects.
Stadium gate 1 opens before the others.
Let the dough rise for 2 hours in a warm place.

notes: Card: top peaks are the token after 'one'/'1' in 'one year after', '1 1/2 - 2 hours', '1 700 m', '1 out of every 3'. Probe: '1 1/2 hours' 0.41 and 0.31, '1 200 litres' 0.34, '1 700 m' 0.36, '1 out of every 4' 0.31; but 'one year after' gave 0.50 once and 0.10 in a second sentence, 'one hour', 'one ton' and 'one month' about 0.03. The unit-of-time reading did not hold, so the label is the continued-number reading.
